rules.sentence: If the person has suspected or confirmed vitamin B12 deficiency because their diet is lacking in vitamin B12:
tell them where to find information on how to improve their intake of vitamin B12, including information about sources in food (see the NHS webpage on B vitamins )
and consider oral vitamin B12 replacement.
When offering oral vitamin B12 replacement in pregnancy or during breastfeeding, consider a dosage of at least 1 mg a day.
